# Catppuccin

Catppuccin brings the full Catppuccin color palettes and accent options to Obsidian. The Latte, Frappe, Macchiato and Mocha variants are chosen through Style Settings, and the theme bundles the Vollkorn editor font for cohesive typography.

![Catppuccin screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catppuccin/obsidian/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Catppuccin"
    author: "catppuccin"
    repo:   "catppuccin/obsidian"
    slug:   "catppuccin"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/catppuccin"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/catppuccin/obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/catppuccin/obsidian/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply the full Catppuccin color palettes and accent options to Obsidian. Choose Latte, Frappé, Macchiato or Mocha via Style Settings and use the bundled Vollkorn editor font for cohesive typography."
}
```
